name: slack-admin-command-surface
objective: Clarify Slack bridge admin command surfaces and guard the docs contract.

userStories.title: Separate Pi and Slack command surfaces
acceptanceCriteria: Slack integration docs state that /msg-bridge is the Pi in-session command surface.
Docs no longer instruct users to run /trusted or /channels inside the Pi session.
Docs state that manifest-backed Slack admin commands are separate from Pi's /msg-bridge surface.
evidence: .oh/docs/integrations/slack.md separates Pi-side /msg-bridge from Slack DM admin text handlers.
.oh/skills/t3/references/sandbox-processes.md no longer says /trusted or /channels are typed into the pane.
Root package audit proves pi-messenger-bridge README separates /msg-bridge commands from Admin commands (in DM with the bot), and source registers only msg-bridge as a Pi command.

userStories.title: Document Slack slash-command caveat and fallback
acceptanceCriteria: .pi/install/slack-manifest.json declares the documented admin slash commands and docs explain how to update an existing Slack app.
Docs provide fallback inspection/config commands: gateway status, tmux capture-pane, jq .auth, and .pi/msg-bridge.json pre-seeding.
Smoke/troubleshooting sections guide users to start with a plain-text DM to trigger challenge auth.
evidence: .oh/docs/integrations/slack.md Admin Slack commands section documents manifest setup, trust, and fallbacks.
.oh/docs/integrations/slack.md Smoke Test and Troubleshooting now recommend a plain-text DM first.
The pinned pi-messenger-bridge fork branch registers Bolt app.command handlers and routes them through ChallengeAuth.handleAdminCommand.

userStories.title: Guard the docs contract
acceptanceCriteria: A Tier-A eval probe checks Slack docs for the command-surface contract.
The probe fails if known misleading phrases reappear.
evidence: Eval probe now requires the root-package audit artifact and package-grounding text in Slack docs.
Eval probe requires manifest command declarations and the bridge fork pin containing Slack command handlers.

userStories.title: Submit a reviewable PR
acceptanceCriteria: The branch is committed and pushed.
The PR targets development, references issue #354, and lists verification commands.
